title: Redundant minLength: 1 emitted on enum-constrained query parameters
author: njheavilin
body_preview: **Describe the bug**  When a ChoiceField is used as a query parameter via @extend_schema(parameters=[...]), the generated parameter schema includes both enum and minLength: 1. For enum-constrained string parameters where all enum values are non-empty, minLength: 1 is redundant because enum already excludes "".
